about_the_game:
Dao Shu Liu Luo is a philosophical puzzle game centered on exploring the panorama of human cognition.
Through the movement and connection of “Yin-Yang Points,” players uncover the hidden logical order behind text, structure, and consciousness.

Each stage represents an independent layer of cognition.
Built upon the deductive logic of Eastern philosophy, the game transforms the flowing balance of Yin and Yang, and the Five Elements, into walkable spatial structures.
The paths you walk are not merely routes of puzzles — they are projections of awareness itself.

In Dao Shu Liu Luo, to walk is to think, and to connect is to understand.

🕹 Features

🌀 Cognitive Puzzles – Interact between Yin and Yang, between self and shadow, to unveil layered structures of awareness.

🌌 Structure as Story – No external narrative. Geometry and energy flow themselves become the storytelling medium.

🧩 Words as Worlds – Each Chinese character unfolds into an explorable spatial form.

⚫ Philosophy Visualized – Experience dynamic interpretations of the Five Elements, Eight Trigrams, and Qimen logic in motion.

🎧 Immersive Atmosphere – A Cyber-Oriental aesthetic blended with minimalist sound design to evoke the stillness of an inner consciousness space.
